titre: Practice test — English (4th year primary, first year) — Term 2

exercices.enonce:
My body.
Label the face. Complete with: eyes - nose - mouth - ears.
1) I have two .......... to see.
2) I have one .......... to smell.
3) I have one .......... to eat.
4) I have two .......... to hear.

exercices.enonce:
My family.
Complete with: father - mother - sister - brother.
1) My dad is my .......... .
2) My mum is my .......... .
3) A girl in my family (not me) is my .......... .
4) A boy in my family (not me) is my .......... .

My clothes.
1) Circle the clothes words: (3 points)
shoes - table - hat - dog - dress.
2) Complete: (2 points)
I wear a .......... on my head when it is sunny. (write a clothes word)

Writing.
Write 3 to 4 sentences about your family and your clothes (who is in your family, what you wear).
